judicialResults.label: Imprisonment
judicialResults.resultText:
IMP - Imprisonment
Committed to prison for 6 Months Concurrent Consecutive to offence Test offence which is on case number XI137534386. Reason: failure to comply with a pre-sentence drug testing order because of an unprovoked attack of a serious nature, because the defendant has a flagrant disregard for court orders. Bail remand days to count (Tagged Days): 0. Number of days in custody in foreign jurisdiction to count: 0. This offence is aggravated by the foreign power condition being met in relation to it as defined by section 31 of the National Security Act 2023. Total custodial period: 3 Years. Consecutive to sentence imposed on 03/09/2026, which was imposed by Bristol Magistrates' Court. Consecutive to all other terms being served. Minimum term: 2 Years. Early release provisions do not apply - sentence is a whole life order. Defendant sentenced without a pre-sentence report because test Reasons for sentence without PSR.
